$description: .NET Backend Academy design tokens, W3C DTCG format. Light theme only (+ high contrast). Layers: ref -> sys -> comp. Aliases use {path}.

palette.$description: Tonal palettes generated from the seed #4A47C2 (hue only; chroma tuned for e-learning). Source: material-color-utilities 0.3.0.

brand.$value: Instrument Serif, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif

plain.$value: Inter, Segoe UI Variable Text, system-ui, sans-serif

code.$value: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, Cascadia Code, Consolas, monospace

label-small.$description: M3 uses 11px; raised to 12px so nothing in the system is below 12px (audit P2).

reading.$description: Academy extension: long-form lesson text. Measure 60-72ch.

code.$description: Code blocks. Ligatures off by default (font-variant-ligatures: none), opt-in per block.

elevation.$description: Tonal elevation: depth comes from the surface-container role, not from shadows. In dark, the same names resolve to the dark scheme. Shadow is reserved for floating layers (drawer, menu): 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .15) in light, none in dark.
